sense_a: The young of a domestic cow.
example_a: The farmer bottle-fed the newborn calf at dawn.
sense_b: The young of various large mammals, such as elephants or whales.
example_b: The whale calf swam close to its mother for the first weeks of life.

sense_a: A person or group accompanying another to give protection, provide supervision, or as a courtesy.
example_a: A police escort accompanied the convoy to the border.
sense_b: A person hired to accompany someone to a social event.
example_b: She hired an escort to attend the gala with her.

sense_a: The upper division of the animal body that contains the brain.
example_a: He turned his head to look over his shoulder.
sense_b: The seat of the intellect; the mind.
example_b: She has a good head for numbers.

sense_a: One of the movable feathered paired appendages by means of which a bird is able to fly.
example_a: The eagle spread its wings and lifted off the cliff.
sense_b: A part or feature of a building projecting from and subordinate to the main or central part.
example_b: The new laboratories are in the east wing of the hospital.

example_a: The bull grazed at the far end of the pasture.
sense_b: A solemn, sealed letter issued by the Pope.
example_b: The papal bull was read aloud in the cathedral.

sense_a: A physical wound or injury to the body.
example_a: The patient was treated for blunt-force trauma after the crash.
sense_b: A deeply distressing or disturbing emotional experience.
example_b: She spent years processing the trauma of her childhood.

sense_a: A small rodent with a pointed snout and a long thin tail.
example_a: A mouse darted across the kitchen floor.
sense_b: A handheld device used to control the cursor on a computer screen.
example_b: He clicked the mouse to open the file.

sense_a: A material made from wood pulp used for writing or printing on.
example_a: She wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
sense_b: A daily or weekly printed publication reporting the news.
example_b: He read about the election in the morning paper.

sense_a: A large long-legged, long-necked wading bird.
example_a: A crane stood motionless in the shallows of the marsh.
sense_b: A tall machine with a projecting arm used for lifting and moving heavy objects.
example_b: The crane hoisted the steel beam to the top floor.

sense_a: The process or period of gathering in crops.
example_a: The whole village helped with the wheat harvest.
sense_b: The result or consequence of an activity, viewed as something gathered.
example_b: The report was the harvest of two years of painstaking research.
